blocks.text: You will hear people speaking in different situations. Match each speaker (15-18) to things they enjoy most about their job(A-F). There are TWO EXTRA options which you do not need to use. Mark your answers on the answer sheet.
You will hear someone giving a talk. Label the places (19-23) on the map (A–I). There are FOUR extra options which you do not need to use. Mark your answers on the answer sheet.
You will hear three extracts. Choose the correct answer (A, B or C) for each question (24-29). There are TWO questions for each extract. Mark your answers on the answer sheet.

Extract One
*You hear two friends talking about a book.*

items.q: What do the friends agree about?
options: A) They find the characters in the book very convincing.
B) They immediately found the storyline absorbing.
C) They would like to see the place where the book was set.

items.q: According to the woman what is the author's reason for writing the book?
options: A) to explore a new aspect of human psychology
B) to show that people have different interpretations of the same event
C) to make an interesting point that no one has made before

blocks.text:
Extract Two
*You hear two people talking about a piece of jewellery.*

items.q: What does the man say about the origins of his bracelet?
options: A) It was chosen as a way to thank him for his hard work.
B) It shows that his uncle had a good opinion of him.
C) It shows he is a man of high rank.

items.q: The woman understands that, for the man, the bracelet represents
options: A) the importance of having clear goals.
B) the role he will have in the future.
C) the need to help other people.

blocks.text:
Extract Three
*You hear two women talking about clothes for a special occasion.*

options: A) the dress Louise tries on is a rather unflattering colour.
B) trouser suits always look like office wear.
C) pashminas are a very adaptable clothing accessory.

items.q: What do we learn about Jack's attitude to clothes?
options: A) He is not worried about his appearance.
B) He rarely buys expensive clothes.
C) He disapproves of designer clothing.

blocks.text: You will hear a part of a lecture. For each question, fill in the missing information in the numbered space. Write no more than ONE WORD for each answer.

blocks.title: BASKETBALL TRAINER
lines: ▪ Bradley says that lack of communication causes most problems in a team.
▪ From his studies, Bradley finds what he learnt about the (30)__________ body particularly useful.
▪ Bradley finds injuries to players' (31)__________ are the most common.
▪ Bradley dismisses most of the new ideas about ways of increasing strength as unhelpful.
▪ Bradley says exercises focusing on improving (32)__________ are the most effective.
▪ Bradley advises players about (33)__________ to help them recover after a match.
▪ Bradley tries to match his approach to the particular (34)__________ in the team.
▪ According to Bradley, it is absolutely essential to have a sense of (35)__________ if you want to succeed as a trainer.
